name: LotkaVolterra
description: 2-species predator-prey chaotic system (Arneodo, Coullet, Tresser; Flake 1998: Computational Beauty of Nature, p. 187). Coupled ODEs solved via 4th-order Runge-Kutta: x' = x*(a - b*y); y' = y*(c*x - d). Outputs (x, y).

inputs.name: h
inputs.description: Integration time step. Higher values increase rate but cause more instability

name: ArneodoCoulletTresser
description: 3-species predator-prey chaotic system (Arneodo, Coullet, Tresser; Flake 1998: Computational Beauty of Nature, p. 187). Coupled ODEs solved via 4th-order Runge-Kutta: x' = x*(1.1 - x/2 - y/2 - z/10); y' = y*(-0.5 + x/2 + y/10 - z/10); z' = z*(alpha + 0.2 - alpha*x - y/10 - z/10). Outputs (x, y, z).

inputs.name: h
inputs.description: Integration time step. Higher values increase rate but cause more instability

name: DNoiseRing
description: Demand-rate shift-register noise generator (Julian Parker & Till Bovermann, 2013). Bitwise-rotates an internal register and stochastically flips bit 0 based on change/chance probabilities. Output is the integer register state interpreted as a float.

inputs.name: change
inputs.description: Probability that bit 0 will be set on each step (0..1)

inputs.name: chance
inputs.description: Probability that the set bit is 1 vs 0 (0..1)

inputs.name: shift
inputs.description: Number of bits to rotate the register right per step

inputs.name: numBits
inputs.description: Width of the rotation register in bits

inputs.name: resetval
inputs.description: Initial value of the register (set on reset)
